about: The people you can rescue (src/rescue.c, mission.c MIS_RESCUE): freed, following you out, holding while they cut loose, and later in town. Placeholders, not the final script.

lines.text: Took you long enough. I know the way up from here. Go.
Three days in a cage. Tell Meridian I want overtime.
Thank you, dear. These old legs can still find the lift.
You came! I mean. Obviously you came. Bye!
My leg's done. Get me back to the entrance and I'll stay behind you.
No gun, no plan. Lead the way to the entrance. I'll keep up.
Slowly, dear. The entrance, and mind the shooting.
Right behind you! Entrance, yes? Please say entrance.
This lock's welded. Twenty seconds with the cutter. Keep them off me.
Chain's thick. Give me twenty seconds and stay close.
I've a hairpin and twenty seconds of patience. Don't wander off.
I can hack it! Twenty seconds! Don't let them near me!
Back on my feet. If you find more of us down there, bring them home.
Meridian docked my pay for the days I was gone. Of course they did.
I've put the kettle on. It's all recycled water, but it's warm.
I'm telling everyone you saved me. I've told everyone twice.
